privacyBody: FaceFind is being developed to help guests find their photos within a single event. Before camera access, guests will be asked for consent. Selfies will be processed in memory for matching and will not be saved. Event face data will expire on the date shown for that event. Photos will be private, and guests will receive access only to their matched photos. A removal option will be provided. Contact details, retention rules, legal basis and processor information must be completed before launch.
